_doc: One scripted edit per corpus file, applied by the writer core to the ProseMirror state in scripts/writer-roundtrip.mjs (step 2 onward, once Task 8 lands). 'find' picks the first text block whose text starts with it. Ops: insertText {find, at: 'start'|'end', text}; insertParagraph {find, text, style?} inserts a new paragraph after the block; toggleMark {find, word, mark: strong|em|underline|strike}; setLink {find, word, href}; setBlockStyle {find, style}; addListItem {find, text} adds an item after the item holding the block; addTableRow {table, cells} appends a row. 'txt' is the change in LibreOffice's plain-text export: the lines that disappear and the lines that appear (compared as multisets). 'adds' names the element counts the edit may raise in the canonical form, beyond which every count must match the original.
